slide1.headline: Cloud Security Report
slide1.subtitle: Traditional security architecture is lagging behind AI transformation

lines: The 2026 Cloud Security Report highlights the gap between traditional security architecture and AI transformation
The report notes that 75% of organizations are using cloud-based services
However, only 25% of these organizations have implemented AI-based security measures
This leaves a significant gap in security coverage

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Meta has launched Muse Spark 1.2, a coding agent with a 1 million-token context window
This is a significant improvement over previous models, which had a context window of 100,000 tokens
The new model is capable of understanding and generating more complex code
This has the potential to revolutionize the field of coding and software development
